summary: Enhanced ARPA/IRA ACA premium subsidies EXPIRED 2025-12-31. 2026 reverted to the pre-ARPA cliff regime (400% FPL cliff back; higher contribution %s) — confirmed against IRS guidance (FS-2025-10, updated as FS-2026-19 on 2026-02-19; Rev. Proc. 2025-25 sets the 2026 9.96% affordability figure). The House 3-year extension (passed 2026-01-08, 230-196) remains STALLED in the Senate as of 2026-07-03; a prior Senate attempt (S 3385) failed cloture; NOTHING enacted, possibly retroactive to 2026 if restored. Adjacent 2026 change (does NOT alter the credit schedule the engine models): excess-APTC repayment caps are REMOVED for tax years after 2025-12-31 (P.L. 119-21) — full repayment of over-advanced credits regardless of income.
howToClear: Re-verify the CURRENT ACA enhanced-subsidy status against an enacted statute / IRS notice, then update verifiedOn + status + summary. Do NOT just bump the date — re-verify the law (it can flip the whole pre-65 model).
